prompts.firstHalf:
Use case: identity-preserve, frame-by-frame 2D character animation.
Create exactly FOUR complete right-facing run sprites in an equal 2x2 grid, genuine transparent alpha background, no labels, floor, diagram, colored marks or shadows. The output is a production full-body sprite sheet, not rig parts.
REFERENCE1: exact character identity/costume/material/proportions. REFERENCE2: exact pose geometry of frames1-4. Its BLUE lines always mean the physical RIGHT/NEAR leg. Its ORANGE lines always mean the physical LEFT/FAR leg. Reference3 is Warrior source motion; preserve broad timing, but prioritize guide2's limb identity and our character's SHORT limb proportions.
CRITICAL: translate the BLUE guide leg into a BRIGHT IVORY NEAR leg (#E8DDCB). Translate ORANGE into a slightly darker shaded warm ivory FAR leg (#B9B09F). NEVER leave colored blue/orange legs. This same near/far physical identity persists across all poses. In ALL FOUR poses of this sheet, the bright near leg is the one moving FORWARD-RIGHT; shaded far leg is behind/recovering. Near leg visually OVERLAPS far leg when they cross; show separate leg openings of shorts. Do not just switch shading on the same leg drawing.
FRAME1 top-left: shaded FAR leg extended diagonally BACK-LEFT/DOWN, its FOOT SOLE FLAT on the common invisible ground baseline. Bright NEAR thigh rises FORWARD-RIGHT almost horizontal, knee tightly folded, calf bends BACK-LEFT under thigh, heel pulled toward underside of shorts. The folded foot is tucked close to pelvis, NOT hanging far below knee. Follow guide1 exactly. This is the most important correction: one very tightly folded front leg, one stretched rear leg supporting on sole.
FRAME2 top-right: both feet airborne. Bright NEAR thigh forward, calf still folded BACK, foot under knee; shaded FAR leg still stretched backward-down, just after release, NOT prematurely curled up.
FRAME3 bottom-left: bright NEAR shin comes DOWN nearly vertical directly below knee, foot approaches ground with toe only gently forward; NO long forward kick. Shaded FAR leg is behind with heel curled upward near backside.
FRAME4 bottom-right: bright NEAR foot planted near under pelvis, knee bent absorbing weight, shaded FAR leg folded passing beneath pelvis. Keep knees/feet as guide. Head/body lowest.
IDENTITY: large round smooth ivory head with one small black oval eye on right side; no mouth/nose/ears/hair/hood. Compact torso, short arms/legs, approximately2.3-head neutral standing height. Soft rounded hands and short feet. Long broad paper cloak wraps front/sides with overlapping front panel, TWO long smooth rear tails flowing LEFT. Front hem raised just enough to expose actual plain SHORTS and knees. Cloak/shorts same warm ivory #D1C7B7, about10% darker than head; no seam stripes, dark pants or boots. Both bare legs same ivory material, only far leg shaded to clearly show depth. Short counter-swinging arms follow run.
STYLE soft matte painterly paper matching reference1, broad smooth curves, restrained grain, no photorealism, no pixelart, no puppet joints. Keep head diameter, eye, costume architecture, lighting constant acrossfour drawings. Head slight height changes from guide, not rigidly pinned. DO NOT straighten or lengthen short legs. Four complete drawings with generous margins in equal cells; no clipping of long cloak. Use same relative position/scale as poseguide, add cloak flowing into empty left area. Important match poseguide legs first, not generic run poses.
